name: panorama-360
description: 360全景浏览器：H5/Web 展示端 + 管理后台

scripts.build:admin: rm -rf server/public/admin/assets server/public/admin/admin.html server/public/admin/customer.html && npm run build -w web-admin
scripts.build:all: npm run build:admin && npm run build:mobile
scripts.restart: pkill -f 'node server/src/index.js'; sleep 1; PORT=3000 node server/src/index.js > /tmp/panorama-server.log 2>&1 &
scripts.test:frontend: npm run test:unit -w web-admin && cd web-app && npm run test:unit
